answer_1.quote: We conduct experiments on Logic Grid Puzzle (Logic), Trivia Creative Writing (Writing) and Codenames Collaborative (Code)... We also evaluate on MMMU, TravelPlanner and ScienceWorld datasets.
answer_1.outputs: travel plans, creative stories, puzzle answers, codeword selections, multimodal reasoning answers

answer_2.quote: We report the accuracy of all questions. For Trivia Creative Writing, we measure the ratio of correctly mentioned answers. For Codenames Collaborative, we calculate the overlapping ratio. Evaluation metrics for TravelPlanner include delivery rate, commonsense constraint pass rate, hard constraint pass rate, and final pass rate.

answer_3.quote: We conduct a quality-check module with an LLM to detect whether the generated agents can satisfy it has inherited the characteristics and maintained differences from parent agents.
